default_file.description: Path to the PDF file to open automatically when Pympress starts.

talk_time.description: Estimated talk time in mm[:ss] format (e.g., '30' or '30:00'). Empty string uses default or manual input.

log_level.description: Verbosity level for the log file. Options: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR.

notes_position.description: Position of notes on the PDF page. Options: none, left, right, top, bottom, auto.

vlc.enabled.description: Enable VLC for playing embedded media. Requires python-vlc.

gstreamer.enabled.description: Enable GStreamer for playing embedded media. Enabled by default.

layout.description: Layout configuration for the presenter window panes.

layout.notes.description: JSON object defining the layout structure. Keys: children (list), proportions (list), orientation (string), resizeable (bool).

keybindings.description: Mapping of action names to key string shortcuts.

cache_size.description: Maximum number of rendered slides to keep in cache.

auto_reload.description: Automatically reload the PDF if the file is modified on disk.

auto_fullscreen.description: Automatically enter fullscreen on the non-primary screen when a second screen is detected.

theme_name.description: GTK theme name. Usually empty to use system default.
